description: Control your Windows PC, VS Code and its terminals (Claude Code included) from your Android phone or a laptop browser. Private over Tailscale, no port forwarding.
notes: Start TermPocket (agent + tray icon) at every logon:
Or start the agent in a console: termpocket-agent
Pair your phone: open http://127.0.0.1:8765/pair on this PC.
Remote access: Tailscale (run "$dir\scripts\setup-tailscale.ps1") or your own relay ("$dir\docs\relay.md").
Before 'scoop uninstall termpocket' run "$dir\scripts\uninstall-autostart.ps1" (stops the agent and its terminals).
